title: Daily Digest A: Injury Watch (Sat Nov 21)
parts:
🩹 DEVYDOSE INJURY WATCH | Sat, Nov 21

Oregon's top back left Friday's win in a boot, LSU's No. 14 WR is out at Tennessee, Michigan goes back to its 5⭐ sophomore QB, and two top-5 QBs on the board are questionable 🧵👇

🩹 DIERRE HILL JR. | Oregon | SO, 4⭐ | #15 RB

Limped off early at Michigan State, in a walking boot after halftime. Dan Lanning: "I don't anticipate this being a long-term injury" (via AP).

🩹 Winston Watkins | LSU | SO, 4⭐ | #14 WR: ruled out (via RotoWire).

✅ BRYCE UNDERWOOD | Michigan | SO, 5⭐ | #25 QB

Michigan is switching back to him against UCLA, per CBS Sports' Matt Zenitz (via Wolverines Wire).

✅ Ryan Hopkins | Wisconsin | FR, 3⭐ | #164 QB: upgraded to probable for Purdue (via Milwaukee Journal Sentinel).

❓ Conner Weigman | Houston | SR, 5⭐ | #5 QB: questionable at West Virginia (via Houston Chronicle).

❓ Drew Mestemaker | Oklahoma State | JR | #4 QB: questionable at Arizona State after a shoulder stinger. (via SI).

Whose status swings your Saturday? 👇
